head.t: Randomised trial finds cyanoacrylate glue comparable to standard of care
head.x: Addressing a “gap” in evidence concerning long-term follow-up and unique complications associated with VenaSeal (Medtronic) cyanoacrylate glue, Kathleen Gibson (Bellevue, USA) presented podium-first randomised data which demonstrated that the device is comparable to standard of care, defined as surgical vein…

head.t: TCT 2026: Medtronic outlines trial of TAVI in moderate aortic stenosis
head.x: Study design and baseline characteristics of patients enrolled in the Evolut EXPAND TAVR II trial were presented today as featured clinical science at the Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT) conference (31 October–3 November, San Diego, USA).

head.t: Medtronic announces positive real-world results on Sphere-9 catheter and PulseSelect PFA system at APHRS 2026
head.x: Medtronic has announced positive real-world registry results for the Affera mapping and ablation system with the Sphere-9 catheter and the PulseSelect pulsed field ablation (PFA) system.

head.t: Medtronic completes separation of MiniMed; diabetes business now independent on Nasdaq (MMED)
head.x: Medtronic exchanged its entire remaining MiniMed stake (252,813,348 shares) through an exchange offer 5.4 times oversubscribed, so MiniMed is now fully independent and trades as MMED on Nasdaq. Medtronic no longer holds equity in it.
